messages:
sarah (product): Quick sync — we need a pragmatic cutover plan for v2 routes covering chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, tool-calls, and structured outputs. Main constraints: minimal customer breakage, clear exemption path, measurable launch gates.
liam (eng-runtime): +1. My proposal: stagger by surface area. Start with embeddings + rerank (low tool coupling), then chat/completions, then tool-calling/structured output. Each stage has a 4-week canary.
maya (customer-success): Echo — a few enterprise customers asked for 3-month runway and an 'opt-out until approved' flag. They won't be able to change pipelines quickly.
david (eng-platform): Implementation note: we can support a shim layer that maps v1 headers to v2 routes. Example header toggle: `X-Redwood-Compat: v1` — helps clients gradually migrate. Need to discuss telemetry tagging.
priyanka (product): Launch criteria idea: 1) No functional regressions on our canonical prompt suite; 2) 99th percentile latency within +10% of baseline; 3) zero severity-1 regressions for 2 weeks; 4) migration docs + sample client libs published. Thoughts?
liam (eng-runtime): Agree. Add: per-route token-cost delta tracked (should not exceed expected quantization/engine change thresholds). We'll add a daily regression job.
nana (ux): small note — update SDK return types for structured output so developers can detect v2 fields. Add a deprecation banner in SDKs for v1 routes.
nana? Sorry wrong handle

maya (customer-success): For customer exemptions: propose an exemptions registry (per-customer expiration + justification). Product sign-off + security approval required for >90 days exemption.

david (eng-platform): Security note: Ana (security) — we need a checklist for private deployments: KMS key rotation and audit events for route fallback. Ana, can you sign off on the exemption flow?

nana finally real reply: Ana (security): Exemption registry is fine. Requirements: 1) time-limited tokens, 2) audit log entry per request when fallback to v1 occurs, 3) review cadence every 30 days for long-lived exemptions.
liam (eng-runtime): Good — we'll emit `x-redwood-compat-exempt: <id>` and record audit events. Also add a telemetry dimension `compat_mode` with values `v1,v2,exempt`.
david (eng-platform): Migration docs: add a migration checklist per surface area. Example for tool-calling: mapping table between v1 tool schema and v2 schema + sample shim code snippet:
```
// shim example
if (req.headers['x-redwood-compat']==='v1') {
  // transform v1 tools => v2 function format
}
```
maya (customer-success): Request: for customers on dedicated/private, offer an opt-in migration window where we can run side-by-side tests with their non-prod environment. They'll need a simple toggle in Console.
priyanka (product): Agreed — Console toggle + audit trail. Also product will publish a deprecation timeline: 6 month soft support (no breaking changes), 12 month hard deprecation for v1 unless customers have approved exemptions.
liam (eng-runtime): Engineers: action items: 1) telemetry dims + daily regression job (owner: liam); 2) shim implementations and tests (owner: david); 3) canary plan per-region and per-route (owner: liam + ops); 4) exemptions registry API (owner: priyanka + ana); ETA: propose initial rollout plan by EOD Fri.
maya (customer-success): I'll collect a prioritized customer list for exemptions and their timelines, share by Wed.
nana again? ignore

priyanka (product): We'll schedule a 30-minute alignment tomorrow to lock gates and rollout dates. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
liam (eng-runtime): one last note — we should publish a compatibility test harness so customers can run their suites against v2 in CI. Low effort, high confidence.
maya (customer-success): Great idea — CS can help beta customers onboard.
david (eng-platform): I'll draft the migration checklist PR and include the shim example + Console toggle spec.
opsbot: canary update: v2-rerank at 2% us-west-2, eu-west-1 at 0.5% pending.
priyanka (product): Closing the thread for now. Meeting invite incoming. Keep all follow-ups in the meeting or create separate threads per route.
